summary: Formats a temperature value into the buffer a2 as an integer with a unit suffix, choosing between Celsius and Fahrenheit formatting based on the global CostDisplayMode flag. When dword_7D0450 equals 1 the Celsius value a1 is converted to Fahrenheit using the linear transform before formatting; otherwise the raw value is formatted.

operations.description: Branch on global dword_7D0450: when it is not equal to 1 the Celsius path is taken.
Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit: v3 = (a1 - -40.0) * 1.8 - 40.0 (linear scale about the -40 degree coincidence point).
Celsius path: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a2, "%4d %s", (int)a1, &byte_5C3734), writing the integer value followed by the Celsius unit suffix buffer.
Fahrenheit path: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a2, "%4d %s", (int)v3, &byte_5C3738), writing the converted integer value followed by the Fahrenheit unit suffix buffer.
Return the result of the selected StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck call.
